simple.summary: הֲדַר (Hădar) means Hadar , an Edomite First listed occurrence: Gen 36 39.

definitions.full: H1924. Hadar הֲדַר proper name, masculine a king in Edom (Aramaic form) Gen 36:39 = הֲדַד (q. v.) 1Chr 1:50 (so here Manuscripts, ⅏ ᵑ6 no doubt rightly, compare Di).
